text:
Maya (CS): Quick update on LumenWorks — they just signaled 2 new internal teams (Search + Business Insights) and a cross-org pilot for reporting. They want to accelerate onboarding and asked about capacity planning. Need SE + infra coordination.
Ian (AM): great — can we get a ballpark ARR upside if both teams go prod?
Maya (CS): rough number from PO is ~$180k/yr if both teams go full. Renewal in 10 months, expanding now reduces churn risk.
Jordan (LumenWorks Ops): FYI from their side: current sandbox traffic ~50 req/s for Search. Expect bursty ramp to ~300 req/s over 6 weeks once ingestion is live. Business Insights wants embeddings + reranking (low-latency p95 target ~150ms). They are under a corporate security policy — prefer VPC/private deployment or Dedicated.
Sam (Solutions Eng): we should size for peak and offer a staged path. Proposal: start Hosted for dev, then shift Search to Dedicated pool (2-4 GPUs) for prod. I can run a throughput projection. Need: sample payloads, average token lengths, and concurrency profile.
Alex (Platform): also need p95 SLO, expected tokens/sec, and whether they accept 8-bit quantization. If they require FP16 and KV cache persistence we might need different kernel tuning.
Maya (CS): I'll capture asks and set a short enablement series. Action items: 1) Jordan to send sample traffic + sample prompts, 2) Sam to produce cost/throughput plan, 3) Alex to flag any infra blockers for Private/VPC.
Jordan (LumenWorks Ops): attaching sample payload (pasted):
```json
{"query":"Find recent product returns for account 12345","history_tokens":45,"max_tokens":256}
```
Jordan (LumenWorks Ops): also: their legal team requires KMS integration and audit logs — that's a gating item for Private.
Sam (Solutions Eng): noted. I can spin up a synthetic load test and share numbers by EOD Thursday. Will try 50->300 req/s ramps with 4s and 1s tails.
Alex (Platform): if they go Dedicated we can propose autoscale policy: min 2 GPUs, max 6 GPUs, with prefix KV cache enabled. That should keep p95 under target for reranking.
Maya (CS): scheduling enablement: propose two 45-min sessions next week (Search deep-dive, Insights embedding pipeline). Sam/Alex available Tue/Wed 10–11 PST?
Sam (Solutions Eng): Tue 10 PST works.
Alex (Platform): Wed 10 is better for me, but I can do Tue 10 if needed.
Maya (CS): Jordan — can you confirm team's availability and share Slack invite?
Jordan (LumenWorks Ops): confirming Tue 10 with both teams. I'll invite their infra lead (Marta) and legal (for KMS Qs).
Ian (AM): this expansion looks healthy; if SE plan shows predictable unit economics we should fast-track Dedicated pricing and a 6-mo pilot discount.
Maya (CS): agree. I'll prepare an enablement agenda and an internal recap after session.
deploy-bot: LumenWorks-prod-invite created and posted to #customerships (automated).
Maya (CS): closing note — capture feedback in the onboarding form: link https://forms.redwood.dev/lumenworks-onboard. I'll follow up with the renewal playbook once we have uptake metrics. :white_check_mark:
